name: promptli-comms
description: Give Codex its own email address and phone number. Send and read email and texts, place calls, and answer people who email, text or call your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Email, SMS and phone calls for Codex
interface.longDescription: Your Codex agent gets its own email address and phone number on Promptli Comms. Send and read email and texts, look up contacts and past conversations, and place calls (the AI always says it is an AI). Optionally run the promptli-codex background service so people can email, text or call the agent and each person gets their own persistent Codex thread.
defaultPrompt: Check my Promptli inbox and summarise anything new.
Text +15551234567 that the build is green.
Set up Promptli Comms so people can email this agent.
